Hoeveel procent van de bewoners van Saba.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT Value, CaribischNederland, Perioden, SoortOverlast FROM "data/nl/odata3/82557NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR SoortOverlast IN ('A047645_2'))) WHERE CaribischNederland IN ('GM9003') AND Perioden IN ('2013JJ00'); SELECT ROUND(((D001636_1 - LAG(D001636_1) OVER (ORDER BY Perioden)) / LAG(D001636_1) OVER (ORDER BY Perioden)) * 100, 2) AS "%" FROM (SELECT D001636_1, Perioden FROM "data/nl/odata3/82659NED.parquet") WHERE GoederenindelingSITC IN ('T001082') AND Perioden IN ('2012JJ00', '2013JJ00')

Wat was in 2023 het gemiddelde jaarbedra.query: SELECT AVG(Value) AS "AVG[Btw]" FROM (SELECT Value, Btw FROM "data/nl/odata3/85592NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('M001013_1')) WHERE Perioden IN ('2023JJ00') AND Btw IN ('A048944', 'A048945'))

Wat was de gemiddelde variabele elektric.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Gemiddelde elektriciteitsprijs' AS Measure, Value, Perioden FROM "data/nl/odata3/85592NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('M007924_2')) WHERE Btw IN ('A048944') AND Perioden IN ('2022JJ00', '2023JJ00', '2024JJ00')) PIVOT(AVG(Value) FOR Perioden IN ('2022JJ00', '2023JJ00', '2024JJ00') GROUP BY Measure) FULL JOIN (SELECT CONCAT_WS(', ', Onderwijs, Perioden) AS Dimension_Measure, SUM(Value) AS "SUM" FROM (SELECT Value, Onderwijs, Perioden FROM "data/nl/odata3/85907NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('M008103'))) WHERE Onderwijs IN ('A010290') AND Perioden IN ('2022JJ00', '2023JJ00', '2024JJ00') GROUP BY Dimension_Measure) AS T2 ON Measure = Dimension_Measure
